decision: write the short-exposure copy back with CLFLUSHOPT instead of CLFLUSH (hal-two-exposures.patch, regenerated from edited trees)
why: CLFLUSH serialises every 64-byte line of the 4.2 MB copy; CLFLUSHOPT writes back and invalidates the same lines and the MFENCE that follows orders it, so PSYS reads the same memory
